recognize_zh: 骨髓切片可見多個巨核細胞，其中不少體積偏小、核為單一圓形或僅輕度分葉（hypolobated），散在於脂肪空泡間的造血組織中，為 MDS del(5q) 常見的巨核細胞形態。
features: Moderately to markedly cellular marrow biopsy with numerous fat spaces
Megakaryocytes readily identified and increased, many medium-sized with round monolobated or hypolobated nuclei
Megakaryocytes distributed singly rather than in tight clusters
Background granulocytic and erythroid precursors with maturation
No obvious blast sheets or fibrosis at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy (H&E, medium power) shows cellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis between fat spaces. Megakaryocytes are increased and many show round monolobated or hypolobated nuclei with relatively small cell size, distributed singly without clustering. No sheets of immature cells or evident fibrosis are seen in this field. The megakaryocytic morphology is suggestive of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q), to be confirmed by cytogenetics.

ddx.vs: ET shows large mature megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated nuclei rather than small monolobated forms.
PMF shows clustered, atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei and reticulin fibrosis.
Hypolobated megakaryocytes are not exclusive to del(5q), so diagnosis rests on karyotype/FISH showing del(5q) without monosomy 7/del(7q).
Reactive megakaryocytes retain normal lobulation and a full size spectrum.
